title: Reply to Member Reviews
text:
## Reply to Member Reviews
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000030830
Want to enhance the member reviews feature on your website? Give members the ability to reply to customer reviews posted on their profiles, and edit their replies whenever needed.
Not only will the members love this feature, but it also generates more unique website content — boosting the websites ranking in search engines.
Websites with the VIP Add-Ons Club automatically have this add-on available: Join The VIP Add-Ons Club
Purchase Individually: Reply To Member Reviews Add-On

## Enabling the Add-On
Navigate to Finance >> Membership Plans:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12085105803/original/89dObdNqHgfn9s0K6ZyxFs12xA11fJhJKg.png?1605626410 | alt: ]
Click on "Edit Settings" for the membership level you would like to activate it for.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12085105880/original/b2ONBdt1i5BJ7vQIE5mW4l57Ufct6L8Hjg.png?1605626465 | alt: ]
Then go to the "Profile Page" tab:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12085106005/original/5K_Lqj_mSiJnDsS3jrcARynctvr4RavZaw.png?1605626600 | alt: ]
And scroll down until you see the Member Review Settings section:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12085106054/original/EMi0qncmJ5-nCV8F6uT7s0m2xlY5C52Uiw.png?1605626659 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181727360/original/Ek83_WU45m09CO6780Bdvp3_RfVA9UgYBg.png?1783546285 | alt: ]

## Replying to Reviews
Once Member Can Reply Reviews is enabled for the membership plan, members can reply to reviews directly from their profile page.
If a reply has already been posted, members can also edit their existing reply from the same location.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181727592/original/dAEKXqN07eYjBc6aTxbU3NQPx-HPRD9osQ.png?1783546709 | alt: ]
